title: European consumer credit registers
gdpr: GDPR is the common data-protection floor across the EEA. It does not unify scores or bureau models. Each country still runs its own positive, negative, or mixed register.

countries.notes: Widely used; score important for rentals, contracts.

bureaus.name: SCHUFA
bureaus.role: Main private credit bureau (Schutzgemeinschaft für allgemeine Kreditsicherung).

bureaus.name: Creditreform / SCHUFA partners
bureaus.role: Business and consumer reporting sits alongside SCHUFA in many contracts.

bureaus.name: BKR (Stichting Bureau Krediet Registratie)
bureaus.role: National credit registration; lenders are generally required to report agreements.

bureaus.name: FICP — Banque de France
bureaus.role: Public file of credit incidents of individuals (Fichier national des Incidents de remboursement des Crédits aux Particuliers).

bureaus.name: Private bureaus
bureaus.role: Commercial files exist beside FICP; the public register remains incident-focused rather than a full positive score.

bureaus.name: ASNEF
bureaus.role: Asociación Nacional de Establecimientos Financieros de Crédito — commonly referenced negative file.

bureaus.name: Experian Spain
bureaus.role: Private bureau used with ASNEF-style delinquency data.

bureaus.name: CRIF
bureaus.role: Largest private credit bureau; EURISC / similar consumer reports.

bureaus.name: CTC
bureaus.role: Consorzio per la Tutela del Credito — private consortium file.

bureaus.name: Central Credit Register (Banca d'Italia)
bureaus.role: Public Centrale dei Rischi for larger exposures; sits next to private bureaus.

bureaus.name: Experian
bureaus.role: One of three nationwide consumer bureaus; own score scale.

bureaus.name: Equifax
bureaus.role: Nationwide file and score, not interchangeable with Experian’s number.

bureaus.name: UC (Sweden)
bureaus.role: Example of a Nordic comprehensive private bureau outside the euro area’s core set above.

bureaus.name: GDPR / EDPB
bureaus.role: Common rules on access, purpose limitation, and data-subject rights — not a single EU credit score.
